independent_interpretation_details.case_two_error: Sdk(NodeQuic(ConnectionLost(TransportError(Error { code: INTERNAL_ERROR, frame: None, reason: "endpoint driver future was dropped" }))))

interpretation: Original six-case diagnostics run 41609675014 completed/failure at exact source 77cfc4e. Build succeeds, all six original exact cases execute independently with ordinary stack, no timeout, and one complete Rust result block each. Cases 1/3/4/5/6 pass; case 2 retains exit 101 and its failed original harness outcome. No case is relabeled.

The original Input/Video safe recovery case 2 reports Sdk(NodeQuic(ConnectionLost(TransportError(INTERNAL_ERROR, endpoint driver future was dropped)))) and completes the failed harness in 1.99 seconds. This archive records the returned failure; ownership-race interpretation and subsequent source repairs require their own review and exact-source rerun.

Previously failing retained-inner/file recovery cases 3/4/5 and full-old-path-loss recovery case 6 pass at this source; their individual success does not erase historical failures and does not replace the complete original network suite or missing target acceptance.

The official ZIP, all eight extracted files, seven producer payload digest entries and complete official raw job log are independently verified. The preexisting diagnostics download is compared byte for byte against the official verified payload without overwriting it. Eleven exact Git source blobs retain workflow, original tests, fixtures and capture-controller helpers.

The separate production SDK DROP producer is not substituted for these six cases. Whole acceptance and release eligibility remain unclaimed. Assertions, ordinary stack, deadlines, selectors, product thresholds and public trust are unchanged. Local audit operations read already uploaded artifact/log/source bytes only; no project build, lint, parser or test runs locally.
